entries.29e423fc691e2ece: Since its establishment in 1958, it has accumulated technology in the special tools field of the machine tool industry. In describing its business, it positions comprehensive supply of machining tools and technical services closely tied to regional markets as important factors for customer satisfaction. entries.60df502935b2582c: As its long-term management vision, under the 'Spirit of Founding' that does not change with the times, the company aims to be a 'company that solves problems on the manufacturing floor', placing importance on its ties with customers and expanding its main businesses of manufacturing and sales of tools, jigs and equipment, and provision of related technology services. Its management strategy aims for 'maximum sales, minimum expenses and shortest time' and states that it will work on verifying results of investment in automation, leveraging technological capabilities and challenging new businesses, complying with laws and strengthening BCP measures and security, and building a global production system. Furthermore, as the supply of tungsten, the main raw material of cemented carbide, becomes unstable, it states that it will procure alternative cemented carbide materials and develop and strengthen tools for electrified vehicles and hybrid vehicles.
